sourceEvidence.claim: Open chest selects G0426 and materializes the first eight linked objects into G0425.
Close clears G0426, resets the container list, then reads current G0425 slots in ascending order and relinks only visited non-empty entries.
Leader-hand put/remove preserves object identity while updating hand state and load.
Chest slot swaps read and mutate current G0425 through remove/remove/put/put ordering.
Icon identity is source-referenced only; the gate uses itemType sentinels and does not claim pixel parity.
Masked bitmap presentation is out of scope for this contract-only runtime gate.

notes: Non-duplicative against existing close-rewire coverage: this gate mutates a G0425 future slot after F0334 has already begun processing the close loop.
